shortDescription: Manage volumes on PowerMax Storage System

options.name: append_vol_id
options.description: Appends volume id to the volume name, Applicable from V4 (Juniper).

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: volume capacity units. If not specified, default value is GB.

options.name: new_name
options.description: The new volume identifier for the volume.

options.name: new_sg_name
options.description: The name of the target storage group.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: rdf_auto_resolve_target
options.description: When true, automatically queries the array to discover the actual remote storage group name. Ignored if I(rdf_target_sg_name) is specified. Applicable only when creating volumes in SRDF-protected storage groups.

options.name: rdf_target_sg_name
options.description: The name of the remote (R2) storage group on the target array. Used when the R2 storage group has a different name from the R1 (source) storage group. If not specified and I(rdf_auto_resolve_target) is false, the R1 storage group name is used. Applicable only when creating volumes in SRDF-protected storage groups.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: sg_name
options.description: The name of the storage group.

options.name: size
options.description: The new size of existing volume. Required for create and expand volume operations.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines whether the volume should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.

options.name: vol_id
options.description: The native id of the volume. Required for rename and delete volume operations.
